description: Samsung's One UI 9 beta version seems to improve the Galaxy S26 Ultra's Privacy Display. When Privacy Display is enabled only for the YouTube APP, minimising a video into picture-in-picture (PiP) mode and returning to the home screen will now keep the privacy feature limited to the floating PiP window. The rest of the interface will be fully visible.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra's Privacy Display Feature Gets a Major Upgrade in One UI 9 Beta

description: India will soon enable payments without an Internet connection on either the customer’s smartphone or the merchant’s PoS terminal. National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) will reportedly begin certifying compatible PoS terminals for enabling offline payments later this year. Offline transactions are expected to be limited to Rs. 2,000 per payment initially. This upcoming feature will help to make digital payments in remote and low-network areas.
title: Offline UPI Payments With NFC Support Could Launch in India Soon

description: OnePlus 11 and newer flagship series smartphones from OnePlus in India will be eligible to receive the ColorOS 17 update, which will be based on Android 17, according to a tipster. Apart from the flagship lineup from OnePlus, select Nord series handsets will reportedly also be eligible to receive the Android 17-based ColorOS 17 update. Apart from the candybar smartphones, the OnePlus Open, the company's book-style foldable handset. will reportedly also receive the Android 17-based ColorOS 17 update.
title: OnePlus 11, Nord 4, and Newer Models Tipped to Receive the Android 17-Based ColorOS 17 Update in India

description: OnePlus N6x design and colour options have been teased. The microsite on Amazon confirms that the OnePlus N6x will go on sale in India in at least blue and red colour options. In terms of design, the OnePlus N6x is shown to feature a flat rear panel, with the centred OnePlus branding placed in the middle of the panel. In the top-left corner of the panel, a pill-shaped rear camera module will be placed on the OnePlus N6x. An LED flash appears next to the camera island. A power button and volume controls will be placed on the right side of the phone. It is shown to feature a flat frame, too. As previously mentioned, the OnePlus N6x is closer to the recently launched OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite than the OnePlus N6.
title: OnePlus N6x Design, Colour Options Teased in New Marketing Material Ahead of Imminent Launch in India

description: Apple's first foldable smartphone has reportedly been spotted in the iOS 27 beta code, according to a report. Expected to be called iPhone Ultra, the foldable is said to pack a multi-battery setup. The report highlights that the code strings say, “The batteries in this iPhone are performing as expected,” and “the health of the batteries in this iPhone has significantly degraded.” The latter appears to be a warning that might appear when the iPhone Ultra’s battery health falls below 80 percent. Similarly, the code strings also reportedly mention specific situations, including one where one of the batteries of the foldable iPhone model might not be a genuine Apple part.
title: Apple’s First Foldable iPhone Reportedly Appears in iOS 27 Beta Code With a Multi-Battery Setup

description: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max spotted on the NBTC website with model number 2609FRA74G. The listing shows support for GSM, WCDMA, LTE and NR networks, indicating 5G connectivity. The listing indicates that the phone could be launched in the global market soon. Additionally, the Redmi Note 17 also appeared on the NBTC database with model number 26081RA18G.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max Appears on Thailand's NBTC Certification Database, Might Launch Soon

description: The Boat Airdopes ProClip comes loaded with interesting features and benefits. The earbuds feature 12mm drivers for good sound output. They use air conduction technology and offer up to 52 hours of playback. The device comes with Bluetooth 6.0 and offers multi-point connectivity. The earbuds are available in three colour options. Check out the review to know more about the latest open-ear earbuds from the company.
title: Boat Airdopes ProClip Review: Built for Everyday Use

description: Dell Alienware 16X Aurora, Alienware 16 Area-51, and Alienware 18 Area-51 gaming laptops have been launched in India. The new models run on Intel Core Ultra 290HX Plus processors and have Nvidia GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs. They offer  Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity options. The Alienware 16X Aurora has a 16-inch WQXGA OLED display with a 240Hz refresh rate. The Dell Alienware 16 Area-51 features a 16-inch WQXGA panel, while the Alienware 18 Area-51 features an 18-inch WQXGA display.
title: Dell Alienware 16X Aurora, Alienware 16 Area-51 and Alienware 18 Area-51 Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung has been rumoured to expand its true wireless stereo (TWS) earphones lineup with the introduction of its first clip-on open-ear style offering. The Galaxy Buds Able, also rumoured as Galaxy Buds On, were initially expected to be unveiled at the Galaxy Unpacked event. However, a recent report suggests that its launch may have been pushed back. The South Korean tech conglomerate is now reportedly re-evaluating the TWS earphones’ release schedule, and the launch could now happen between late September and October.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds Able to Reportedly Skip Galaxy Unpacked Launch; Could Debut in October

description: X for Android app has been revamped with the latest update, the microblogging platform announced on Monday. X Head of Product Nikita Bier announced that the development of the revamped X app for Android is now complete, after being in development for more than a year. The company said in a post on X that the revamped X for Android app is “faster, smoother, and more reliable” when compared to the previous version in multiple aspects. On top of this, since the app has been rebuilt, the company has modernised the “foundation” of the Android app, which helps in improving the user experience in terms of “scrolling, loading, and notifications”.
title: X for Android App Undergoes Major Design Overhaul, Enhanced Performance and Reliability

description: Redmi 17 4G is reportedly listed on the EPREL website with model number 2606FRN72Y. The listing shows the phone with a 7,500mAh battery with 45W charging support. The battery could last up to 73 hours and 54 minutes on a single charge. The Redmi 17 4G is rumoured to feature a 6.9-inch display and a MediaTek Helio G91 Ultra chipset. It has an IP65-rated build for dust and water resistance.
title: Redmi 17 4G EPREL Certification Listing Gives an Early Look at Its Specifications

description: Xiaomi Pad 9 has been spotted on the 3C certification website in China. The tablet has reportedly been listed with the model number M656BA. Separately, a tipster has shared additional details about the upcoming tablet. The rumoured Xiaomi Pad 9 will be powered by an octa core Snapdragon 8 series chipset. Moreover, it is said to pack a 9,720mAh battery, which is notably larger than its predecessor. The tablet will reportedly launch with support for 45W wired fast charging. The Xiaomi Pad 9 is expected to launch this year along with the Xiaomi 18 lineup.
title: Xiaomi Pad 9 Could Launch Soon With a Bigger Battery, Certification Listing Suggests: Expected Specifications

description: Samsung is expected to release its Android 17-based One UI 9 update with the upcoming Galaxy foldables later this month. Ahead of its anticipated release, the South Korean tech conglomerate appears to be expanding the development of the software to more Galaxy devices. Based on a tipster’s claims, internal One UI 9 test builds have been spotted for the Galaxy A55 and Galaxy A35 in South Korea. Both handsets, notably, were originally shipped with Android 14.
title: Samsung Galaxy A55, Galaxy A35 One UI 9 Test Builds Reportedly Spotted Ahead of Android 17 Rollout

description: Oppo Find X10 series is said to include three models. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max is tipped to come with a 6.78-inch 1.5K flat display. It could run on a MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset and include a 200-megapixel HPC sensor. The Oppo Find X10 is said to feature a 6.59-inch 1.5K display and a new MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Lite processor. The Find X10 Pro is tipped to come with a 6.78-inch 1.5K display and a 2nm Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset.
title: Oppo Find X10 Series Leak Reveals Chipset, Display Details; Find X10 Pro Max Tipped to Get Dimensity 9600 Pro

description: iQOO 16 is expected to be unveiled as the Vivo sub-brand’s latest flagship later this year. The rumour mill now suggests that the company is also working on another addition to the flagship lineup, which could debut as the iQOO 16T. While iQOO has yet to confirm any plans, a tipster has shed light on the processor that could power the purported handset. It is tipped to feature Qualcomm’s next-generation flagship chipset under the hood. The leak also reveals information about its display and thermal management.
title: iQOO 16T Tipped to Feature Next-Generation MediaTek or Qualcomm Chip; Key Specifications Leak

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE and Galaxy Tab S12 reportedly spotted in the Google app. A screenshot of the listing shows the devices as 'Tab S12' and 'S26 FE' without the Galaxy branding. This new listing shows that Samsung could be gearing up to unveil the Fan Edition smartphone and Galaxy Tab S12 series soon. It is likely to debut as a successor to last year's Galaxy S25 FE. It could run on the Exynos 2500 chipset and include 12GB of RAM.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, Galaxy Tab S12 Reportedly Spotted in Google App Listing, Hinting at Imminent Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy Watch 9 will be powered by a five-core Snapdragon Wear Elite chipset, a report recently claimed. The chipset has reportedly been listed on the Geekbench benchmarking platform, revealing the performance the smartwatch might offer. It managed to score 573 points on Geekbench’s single-core performance test and 1,069 points on the multi-core performance test. Appearing with the codename Qualcomm Vienna, the Samsung Galaxy Watch 9’s Snapdragon Wear Elite SoC is shown to feature four efficiency cores clocked at 1.96GHz and a prime core, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.11GHz. It also appears with 3.50GB of RAM, which is expected to be marketed as 4GB of RAM.
title: Samsung Galaxy Watch 9 Leak Reveals Major Chipset Upgrade Before Galaxy Unpacked

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 has leaked in a fresh set of official-looking renders just ahead of Samsung's Galaxy Unpacked event. The images showcase the wider cover display, slimmer chassis and multiple colour options.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Fresh Renders Leaked Online Just Ahead of Galaxy Unpacked Event

description: Redmi Watch 6 Active and Redmi Watch 6 Lite could be launched soon, as key details regarding the two smartwatches have surfaced online, including their prices, colour options, key specifications, and features. The Redmi Watch 6 Active and Watch 6 Lite will reportedly be equipped with a 470mAh battery, which would be slightly smaller than the standard model. Both smartwatches are expected to offer multiple health tracking features, including heart rate monitoring, SpO₂ (blood oxygen) tracking, sleep tracking, distance tracking, calories burned tracking, and a pedometer. However, an exact launch date remains under wraps.
title: Redmi Watch 6 Active, Watch 6 Lite Price, Key Specifications, and Other Details Leaked Online

description: The Tecno Camon 50 Ultra packs a premium design language and offers a slim profile of just 7.6mm thickness. The handset packs a 6.78-inch 1.5K ProXDR curved AMOLED display with a resolution of 1208 x 2644 pixels. The screen also comes with up to a 144Hz screen refresh rate and Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection.
title: Tecno Camon 50 Ultra 5G Goes on Sale in India With Dimensity 7400 Ultimate SoC: Price, Offers

description: The Redmi Note 17 series was launched in China last week, and the lineup now appears to be headed to India. While the Xiaomi sub-brand has yet to confirm any details, a tipster has revealed the anticipated launch timeline of the standard Redmi Note 17, alongside some of the key specifications of the Indian variant. The handset is tipped to pack an 8,000mAh battery. It could feature an OLED screen and a 50-megapixel primary rear camera.
title: Redmi Note 17 India Launch Date Leaked as Tipster Confirms Indian Variant’s Key Specifications

description: Samsung is set to unveil its next generation of foldables smartphones and smartwatches at its Galaxy Unpacked event later this week. Ahead of the launch, purported European pricing for the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, Galaxy Z Flip 8, Galaxy Watch 9, and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 has surfaced on an online retailer's website. Samsung's upcoming Galaxy foldables and wearables are expected to see price hikes in several European markets, while the listing also reveals the storage configurations.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Z Fold 8 Ultra, Z Flip 8, Galaxy Watch 9 Prices Leak Ahead of Galaxy Unpacked
